thread_text:
tara-peopleops: Quick idea 11 a micro-template for cross-functional OKRs so PMs and Eng managers can align before calibration. Needs to be 1 paragraph + 3 bullets max. Anyone want to help word it? :sparkles:

kevin-pm: Would be great. My ask: make explicit owner, dependency list, and a 1-line success metric. Keep it copyable into PR descriptions.

anita-eng: Also include a tiny "quality guardrails" line (e.g., acceptable error/noise) so infra teams know rollback thresholds.

sam-engineer: Add a one-line fallback plan if the metric starts drifting. Helps signal we anticipated failure modes.

tara-peopleops: Nice. Draft below 11 copyable and one-paragraph so it fits in a 1:1 or PR.

---
`Cross-team OKR One-paragraph (copyable)`
Goal (one line): [owner] will deliver [short outcome] by [date] to achieve [impact]. Success metric: [metric / baseline 1 target]. Dependencies: [team A, infra quota, PR link]. Quality guardrail: [acceptable regression threshold or error budget]. Fallback plan (1 line): [if metric regresses, do X and notify Y].

Example: "(kevin) Reduce web p95 from 220ms -> <=140ms by 2026-06-30 to improve conversion. Success: p95 <= 140ms (baseline 220ms). Dependencies: infra GPU quota, model X eval (#123). Quality guardrail: no more than 2% throughput error increase. Fallback: revert to model v2 and run postmortem; notify infra and product."

`How managers should use`
- Paste into a 1:1 or the project PR description.
- Keep the paragraph visible in the team roadmap and in the calibration folder as a short evidence artifact (2 bullets with dates).
- Timebox discussion to 10 minutes in a 1:1; escalate complex dependency negotiation to a sync with stakeholders.

`Manager phrasing samples`
- Alignment: "This paragraph is helpful 1 it clearly names the owner and deps; would you add the PR link before milestone planning?"
- Support: "If GPU quota is the blocker, I can escalate with infra and draft a temporary burst plan."
- Calibration note: "For calibration, paste 2 short evidence bullets (dates + links) showing progress or impact."
---

kevin-pm: This is slick 1 will paste in our next planning PR. Could we also have a one-line variant for individual goals tied to the OKR?

anita-eng: One-line variant would be: "I will implement canary and automated smoke checks to keep p95 under target; owner: anita; due: date; evidence: link."

sam-engineer: Perfect. Can we get a tiny Notion card and a Slack snippet? I can help wire a Slack snippet if you want.

tara-peopleops: I'll add both to the playbook and post a Notion card. Sam, I'll DM you for snippet help.
